set.body: Owner: ScalaFIM fmri-workflow. Existing catalog compilation and FirstLevelUnitSource open selected BOLD/masks but no events/confound-to-model binder exists in this module. Add public shared table binding and JVM selected-artifact loading; preserve run order, labels, selected confound names and diagnostics; validate row counts and refuse conflicts/missing inputs. Reuse BIDS4s parsing/selection and ScalaFIM dataset/model APIs. No filename re-discovery or application-local scientific loader. Acceptance: shared JVM/JS checks for run order, duplicate/missing runs, conflicting run fields, malformed events and confound length; JVM selected-file ingestion to condition/FIR fit, unrelated malformed files ignored; downstream plsneuro E0.6 integration.
set.title: Bind selected first-level unit tables into dataset and model inputs
